The '''WPR-60''' was a [[water purifier]] manufactured by [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]]. Microbiological agents, heating and radiation elements eliminated over 99% of harmful contaminants, rendering [[Water/Legends|water]] safe to drink.
